name: Tihama and the Southern Gate
inspired_by: Western and central Yemen and the southern Red Sea as of 2026: the hot Tihama coastal plain with fishing towns and a strait island at the southern gate (Bab al-Mandab type), a steep escarpment rising to terraced highlands with stone tower-house villages, and interior desert wadis with mud-brick tower towns to the east. The Houthis hold most of the coast and highlands after their September 2026 advance; AQAP operates in the interior wadis. All towns are fictional.
climate: Three bands. Tihama coast: hot desert with very high humidity (Koppen BWh), 32-42 C, under 100 mm rain. Highlands (2,000-2,800 m): temperate (Cwb), 20-28 C days, cool nights, frost in winter, 300-700 mm rain in two monsoon-fed seasons (March-May and July-September). Interior wadis: hot desert (BWh), 35-45 C in summer, rare flash floods.
seasons: Winter (Dec-Feb): mild coast, cold highland nights with frost, dry
Spring rains (Mar-May): highland thunderstorms, flash floods in wadis
Summer (Jun-Sep): extreme humid heat on the coast, khamsin and dust from the interior, main rains on the escarpment
Autumn (Oct-Nov): harvest of sorghum on the terraces, clear air in the highlands

vegetation: irrigated sorghum, millet and mango in wadi deltas
bare volcanic rock on the strait island
dragon's blood and Euphorbia succulents on cliffs
Ficus and tamarind in wadi beds
coffee and banana terraces in wet gorges
date palm and sidr (Ziziphus spina-christi) in wadi floors
irrigated sorghum and alfalfa near towns
sand sheets at the desert edge

terrain.relief: A flat coastal plain 4-8 km wide on the west rises abruptly up a 1,500-2,000 m escarpment cut by deep gorges to rolling, terraced highland plateaus and volcanic peaks (2,000-2,800 m); east of the highlands the land drops to a flat-topped sandstone plateau dissected by steep-walled canyon wadis (800-1,200 m).
features: the strait island of dark volcanic rock with a lighthouse
escarpment gorges with waterfalls in the rains
volcanic cones and basalt flows on the plateau
flat-topped plateau with canyon wadis in the east
ancient dam remains and water cisterns
terrain.water: Red Sea and the strait on the west and south-west; seasonal rivers (sayl) flowing down from the escarpment that spread into irrigated deltas on the Tihama; cisterns and wells in the highlands; flash floods in the eastern wadis.

generator.approach: Heightmap at 10 m. Three bands built west to east: (a) coastal plain with dune noise and wadi deltas; (b) an escarpment as a steep sigmoid step (1,800 m over 4 km) broken by ridged noise and carved gorges; (c) highland plateau with fbm hills and volcanic cones, then a gentler eastern descent to the sandstone plateau where canyons are carved as deep, narrow, flat-floored channels. Terraces post-pass over the whole highland band on 8-35 degree slopes.

noise_layers.purpose: the escarpment line, warped so it is irregular with spurs
rolling plateau and eastern jol surface

generator.erosion: Strong hydraulic erosion on the escarpment (100 iterations) for deep gorges; canyon carving in the east as a separate pass (flow lines widened to 100-400 m flat floors with vertical walls); thermal erosion capped at 60 degrees in canyons.
generator.rivers: Seasonal: gorges from flow accumulation down the escarpment, ending in alluvial deltas on the Tihama with irrigation channels; eastern wadis as flat-floored canyons with palm gardens. No perennial river.
generator.settlement_flattening: Tihama towns flattened; highland villages on ridge crests and spurs per plot, never flattening terraces; eastern tower towns on wadi-side benches above flood level.
generator.notes: The escarpment roads (2 switchback roads, one through a gorge) are the decisive chokepoints between coast and highlands. AAVs only on the coastal band; helicopters struggle with altitude and storms in the highlands (proposed).

settlements.architecture: Highland stone tower-house village: three- to six-storey houses of dressed stone (lower floors) and brick or stone above, small windows with white gypsum frames and alabaster or stained-glass fanlights (qamariya), flat roofs with parapets; livestock on the ground floor, a top-floor reception room (mafraj); villages perched on ridge crests like fortresses.
settlements.wall_class: Stone walls 60-90 cm thick at the base (very strong cover); upper brick 30 cm medium.
layout_rules: on a ridge crest or spur, houses packed together forming an outer wall
one gate and a steep road; footpaths down to terraces
a mosque with a white minaret
cisterns and threshing floors at the edge

settlements.architecture: Tihama coastal town: one- and two-storey houses of brick and plaster with carved and painted decoration, courtyards, reed-and-wood huts (ushash, conical thatched) on the outskirts; concrete blocks of two to four storeys on the main road; a fishing harbour with wooden boats, a fish market and a mosque.
settlements.wall_class: Brick-and-plaster houses medium; huts none; concrete blocks frames thick.
layout_rules: old quarter of lanes around a mosque and souq
coastal highway as the main street

settlements.architecture: Interior wadi tower town: five- to eight-storey mud-brick tower houses, rendered with lime at the top, small windows, flat roofs; packed into a walled block on a wadi-side bench; palm gardens below.
settlements.wall_class: Mud-brick walls 80-100 cm at the base (thick cover) but crumble under sustained fire; upper walls 40 cm.
layout_rules: dense walled block, streets 2-4 m wide
single gate facing the wadi road
palm gardens and fields on the wadi floor

settlements.architecture: Displacement settlement: tents, reed huts and tin shelters, water tanks, a clinic tent.
layout_rules: on open ground near a town or road
aid distribution point at the entrance

settlements.architecture: Military and infrastructure sites: Houthi positions in caves and bunkers on the escarpment, coastal launch sites under camouflage, an ex-army base with tank revetments, government-aligned posts in the interior, the strait island garrison, an oil pumping station on the eastern plateau.
settlements.wall_class: Caves and bunkers effectively indestructible; sandbag and stone sangars thick; sheds thin.
layout_rules: escarpment and ridge positions with views over roads
coastal sites hidden in palm groves

infrastructure.roads: Coastal highway on the Tihama, two switchback roads and one gorge road up the escarpment to the highlands, rough highland roads between ridge villages, a desert road east across the plateau. Many bridges damaged; sand and flood washouts.
infrastructure.power: Grid largely down; solar panels on every roof, generators, a damaged coastal power station.
infrastructure.ports: A small commercial port and many fishing harbours on the coast; the strait island jetty.
infrastructure.airfields: A damaged regional airport on the Tihama, a military airstrip on the strait island (out of use), dirt strips in the interior.
infrastructure.checkpoints: Houthi checkpoints on the coastal highway and every escarpment road (sandbags, a hut, a slogan banner); government-aligned and tribal checkpoints in the interior; smuggling landings on beaches.

pois.description: Launch site in a doum palm grove near the coast: camouflage nets over trucks, a shed, fuel drums and launch-rail debris; drone and missile parts (game-level).
pois.contract_use: locate and document for a client; recover sensitive debris (clients sau, usa)

pois.description: Hairpin road climbing the escarpment with stone sangars above, a broken guardrail, a burnt truck and a checkpoint at the top.
pois.contract_use: convoy escort chokepoint; aid convoy to the highlands

pois.description: Stone tower-house village on a ridge crest with a single gate; overwatch over two valleys.
pois.contract_use: HVT location; hot-zone outpost; rescue a downed aircrew sheltered there

pois.description: AQAP camp in a side canyon of an eastern wadi: tents under rock overhangs, a vehicle park of Hiluxes, a training area, an observation post on the rim.
pois.contract_use: HVT capture or camp raid (clients sau, are)

pois.description: Fishing harbour with wooden boats, ice plant and a beach landing used for smuggling; warehouses behind the beach.
Volcanic island in the strait with a lighthouse, a garrison, an old airstrip and a jetty; overlooks the shipping lane.
pois.contract_use: hot-zone objective; observation from sea; recover a seized crew held there

pois.description: Merchant ship held at anchor off the coast; guards on the bridge; the crew held below.
pois.contract_use: recover seized ship crew (client are, gbr)

pois.description: Crash site of a helicopter or jet on the terraces; wreckage, survivors' hide in a terrace wall, villagers approaching.
Northern border post with stone and sandbag positions, a container barracks, a fence and a watchtower on a hill.
Aid warehouse and distribution point in a coastal town: lorries, stacked sacks, crowds at distribution hours.
Pumping station on the eastern plateau with a pipeline, tanks and a fenced compound; previously struck by drones.
pois.contract_use: counter-drone defence of an oil facility (client sau)

pois.description: Ancient dam and sluice ruins in a wadi, massive cut-stone walls, a visitor hut; good cover and a meeting site.

conditions: clear and extremely hot and humid (coast)
weather.visibility_notes: Coastal haze and heat shimmer; highland cloud covers the escarpment top in the afternoon; dust storms in summer ground helicopters; very dark rural nights.
weather.dust_or_snow: Dust common on the coast and in the east from May to August; frost but no snow in the highlands.

civilians.behaviour: Morning markets on the coast; highland farmers on terraces; afternoon qat-chewing sessions empty the streets 14:00-18:00 and fill the mafraj rooms; men often carry rifles openly, which is a readable but not hostile cue; children herding goats. Displacement camps along the coastal highway. Civilians flee uphill on foot in the highlands and along the highway on the coast.
vehicles: old Toyota Land Cruisers and Hiluxes
civilians.casualty_risk_notes: Armed civilians are common, so identification matters; camps and coastal towns are dense; the casualty rule bites in highland villages where houses are packed together.

factions_present.where: Coastal plain and towns, the strait island, the escarpment and highland villages; launch sites in palm groves; checkpoints on every escarpment road; fast boats offshore.
Interior desert wadis and side canyons in the east; raids on the desert road and pumping station.
Northern border posts on the map edge, the eastern oil pumping station, air strikes over Houthi areas (AI aircraft only), support to government-aligned posts in the east.
Offshore and in contracts only (UAE forces withdrew from Yemen in December 2025): a naval vessel and liaison with southern partner forces at the east edge.
Naval patrol in the Red Sea shipping lane.
Advisers with Houthi missile and drone teams; smuggling dhows at sea.
Strikes on the port and power station (AI aircraft only); no ground presence.
Warships and helicopters in the Red Sea, drones over the coast.
Warship and boarding teams in the shipping lane.
Escort frigate in the shipping lane.
Destroyer on anti-piracy and escort duty.
Contracted forces holding coastal enclaves, port warehouses and the eastern road for Gulf-linked clients; armed escort boats.
Embarked ship security teams and an aid-agency security contract in a coastal town.

frontline: The Houthi line runs along the coast and the escarpment; the east is a three-way space (AQAP, government-aligned posts, Black Sable enclaves). The war sim moves Houthi control down the coast toward the strait in escalation phases (as in September 2026) and back in counter-offensives supported by Saudi air strikes; each Houthi-held coastal zone adds fast-boat and launch-site activity offshore. AQAP raids flip eastern road zones to contested; successful HVT and camp raids clear them. Shipping attacks post escort and ship-recovery contracts at sea.

Escort an aid convoy up an escarpment switchback (client sau)

Counter-drone defence of the eastern pumping station (client sau)
Protect Red Sea shipping: escort a merchant ship past the strait island (clients grc, ita, gbr, ind, usa)

hot_zones.name: Strait coast and island
hot_zones.layout: houthis HQ in a coastal town compound; 4 outposts (strait island, two launch sites, a harbour); checkpoints on the coastal highway; roaming technicals and fast boats; 1 QRF of technicals plus a boat group

hot_zones.name: Eastern wadis
hot_zones.layout: aqap HQ in a canyon camp; 3 outposts on rims and in a tower town edge; checkpoints on the desert road; motorbike patrols; 1 QRF of Hiluxes (early-game hot zone)

insertion.fob: LHD offshore in the Red Sea for coastal and strait contracts. For the eastern wadis, a FOB at a government-aligned airstrip on the plateau, reached by helicopter; AAVs only on the coastal band.

early_game_notes: The eastern wadis (aqap, early tier) are the early-game area; Houthi coastal and highland zones (mid tier) open later.
